claims.object_text: rat GRIA2 flip-Q isoform structure at 2.3-2.6 Å resolution
claims.quote: Here we investigated putative ion and water densities in the open pore of Ca2+-permeable AMPARs (rat GRIA2 flip-Q isoform) at 2.3-2.6 Å resolution.

claims.object_text: extracellular Ca2+ binding site (site-G) forms when channel gate opens
claims.quote: We show that the ion permeation pathway attains an extracellular Ca2+ binding site (site-G) when the channel gate moves into the open configuration.

claims.object_text: site-G is selective for Ca2+ over Na+ and favors Ca2+ movement into the selectivity filter
claims.quote: Site-G is highly selective for Ca2+ over Na+, favoring the movement of Ca2+ into the selectivity filter of the pore.
attenuates Ca2+ binding and thus diminishes Ca2+ permeability

claims.object_text: site-G coordinates with the Q/R site to ensure preferential Ca2+ transport
claims.quote: site-G, which coordinates with the Q/R site of the selectivity filter to ensure the preferential transport of Ca2+ through the channel pore.
